notes.title: [Update Notice Including Bug Fixes ver1.0.2]
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you very much for playing Forbidden Ground - Lair of Aooni.[/p][p]We are pleased to announce the release of version 1.0.2, which includes several bug fixes.
[/p][p][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/p][p]・Fixed minor issues during the charging tutorial[/p][p]・Fixed missing cursor display in some choices[/p][p]・Fixed flashlight direction control issues[/p][p]・Fixed bug allowing item selection from previous scene after scene transition[/p][p]・Fixed button guide display issues[/p][p]・Fixed progression-stopping bug occurring at specific timing[/p][p]・Fixed resume position bug when continuing gameplay[/p][p]・Fixed issues with dialogue and guide display[/p][p]・Fixed display issues while hiding[/p][p]・Fixed ending branching bug under specific conditions
[/p][p][b]\[Adjustments][/b][/p][p]・Applied "?" display to the distribution board[/p][p]・Changed initial cursor display position[/p][p]・Adjusted action icon display position[/p][p]・Adjusted Aooni behavior and placement[/p][p]・Enabled character control immediately after scene transition[/p][p]・Adjusted voice volume[/p][p]・Ensured proper playback of sound effects
[/p][p][b]\[Text Improvements][/b][/p][p]・Improved text quality in English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese
[/p][p]We will continue striving to provide a comfortable gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: [Important: Notice from the Forbidden Ground Development Team #2]
notes.notes: [p]To everyone who has purchased Forbidden Ground - Lair of Aooni,[/p][p]And to those considering purchasing the game,[/p][p][/p][p]This is a follow-up regarding the content improvements we previously announced.[/p][p][/p][p][b]★We are currently working to deliver the improvement patch by the end of this month.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]To enhance the areas that have received positive feedback and improve the overall gameplay experience, we will be addressing the following issues:[/p][p][/p][p]・Improved hint information for progression[/p][p]・Adjustments to rescue events[/p][p]・Changes to map structure[/p][p]・Tweaks to door opening/closing behavior[/p][p]・Changes to Aooni spawn locations[/p][p]・Adjustments to Aooni spawn probability[/p][p]・Other minor adjustments[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely apologize for not being able to provide the best gameplay experience thus far.[/p][p]We are committed to making this title as enjoyable as possible, and we deeply appreciate your continued support and encouragement.[/p][p][/p][p]— Forbidden Ground Development Team —[/p]

notes.title: [Important: Notice from the Forbidden Ground Development Team]
notes.notes: [p]Thank you very much for purchasing Forbidden Ground - Lair of Aooni.[/p][p][/p][p]The development team is sincerely listening to the valuable feedback we’ve received from players and is currently working on improvements.[/p][p]We are prioritizing the following issues:[/p][p][/p][p]・Difficulty understanding hints during gameplay[/p][p]・Player controls and certain events causing stress[/p][p]・Issues related to Ao Oni’s appearance algorithm[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, we are formulating a broader improvement plan that includes other feedback and suggestions.[/p][p]We will address these issues as quickly as possible.[/p][p]The specific update release date will be announced at a later time.[/p][p]We will continue to listen to your voices and strive to deliver the best possible experience.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p][/p][p]— The Forbidden Ground Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Regarding Issues with Simplified and Traditional Chinese Localization
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]Thank you very much for purchasing our game. We sincerely appreciate your support.[/p][p][/p][p]We have reviewed the feedback and requests received from the community regarding the Simplified and Traditional Chinese localizations for this title.[/p][p]We are currently prioritizing fixes and improvements for the following points:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]1.  Correcting inconsistencies in terminology[/p][p]2.  Fixing areas where discrepancies from the original text are noticeable[/p][p]3.  Correcting identified omissions and mistranslations[/p][p]4.  Fixing instances of mixed Traditional and Simplified Chinese (including UI elements)[/p][p]5. Improving the quality of localized text[/p][p][/p][p]We are actively working to address these issues for the next update.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.[/p][p][/p][p]We deeply appreciate your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Forbidden Ground: Lair of Aooni – Launches on Friday, August 29!
notes.notes: [h3]We are pleased to announce that [i]Forbidden Ground: Lair of Aooni[/i] will be officially released on [b]Friday, August 29, 2025[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]The 1st trailer has also been unveiled—please be sure to check it out![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://kinsokuchi.com/index_en.html"]Official Website[/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ae7xOuwSnSs;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: We exhibited at BitSummit the 13th: Summer of Yokai!
notes.notes: [p][i]“[b]Forbidden Ground: Lair of Aooni[/b]”[/i] was showcased as a playable demo at the [b]HYDE booth[/b] during [b]BitSummit the 13th: Summer of Yokai[/b], held at [b]Miyakomesse in Kyoto[/b] from [b]July 18 (Fri) to July 20 (Sun), 2025[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695427/9eecab734fdfd3df8e2250ca45a73d44da974149.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695427/f8ba9b6862c9cac35d746f001ab5f4b82b16b941.jpg"][/img][/p][p]An impressive AOONI will be appearing in the booth, and visitors will receive a limited edition AOONI fan as a gift![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695427/b7c330e6ca022e7a3ca90605c291bacd4a1b4f6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to your amazing support, the booth was packed with players and full of energy throughout the event.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695427/7ad49a1ae94a626c02bdca1132e6a4029890d1d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]On the final day, the AOONI [b]came to life[/b], creating a wave of excitement among the crowd![/p][p][/p][p]We also received many heartfelt messages from players who tried the demo—it truly encouraged our team.[/p][p]Thank you all so much for stopping by![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you’ll continue to look forward to the release![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: BitSummit the 13th Summer of Yokai
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to announce that [i]“[b]Forbidden Ground: Lair of Aooni[/b]”[/i] will be featured as a [b]playable demo[/b] at the [b]BitSummit the 13th: Summer of Yokai[/b], taking place from [b]Friday, July 18 to Sunday, July 20, 2025[/b], at the [b]Hyde Booth[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]• [b]Dates[/b]: July 18 (Fri) – July 20 (Sun), 2025[/p][p]※Please note: July 18 (Fri) is a [b]Business Day[/b] and not open to the general public.[/p][p]• [b]Time[/b]: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM[/p][p]• [b]Venue[/b]: Kyoto International Exhibition Hall “Miyakomesse”[/p][p]• [b]Official Website[/b]: [url="https://bitsummit.org/"]https://bitsummit.org/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]• [b]Booth Location[/b]: 1F, Exhibition Hall 2, Booth BZ-10[/p][p][/p][p]At our booth, you’ll be able to play [b]“[i]Forbidden Ground: Lair of Aooni[/i]”[/b], receive a [b]special limited-edition fan[/b], and be greeted by a [b]high-quality Blue Demon mascot[/b]![/p][p]We look forward to seeing you there![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695427/b2c56a37780ddbd3a5a14430e751b3da80eb68ca.png"][/img][/p]
